per_case_results.question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.

per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "l"."format", "c"."name"
FROM "cards" "c"
JOIN "legalities" "l" ON "c"."id" = "l"."id"
WHERE "l"."status" = 'banned'
  AND "l"."format" = (
    SELECT "format"
    FROM "legalities" "l2"
    JOIN "cards" "c2" ON "l2"."id" = "c2"."id"
    WHERE "l2"."status" = 'banned'
    GROUP BY "format"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )

per_case_results.question: Which cards are ranked 1st on EDHRec? List all of the cards name and its banned play format.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.format FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.edhrecRank = 1 AND T2.status = 'Banned' GROUP BY T1.name, T2.format
per_case_results.actual_sql:

FROM "cards" "c"
JOIN "legalities" "l" ON "c"."id" = "l"."id"
WHERE "c"."edhrecrank" = 1 AND "l"."status" = 'banned'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: List the names of all the cards in the set Hour of Devastation and find the formats in which these cards are legal.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name, CASE WHEN T1.status = 'Legal' THEN T1.format ELSE NULL END FROM legalities AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T2.setCode IN (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Hour of Devastation')
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "cards"."name", "legalities"."format"
FROM "cards"
JOIN "legalities" ON "cards"."id" = "legalities"."id"
WHERE "cards"."setcode" = 'HOU'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Find and list the names of sets which doesn't have Japanese translation but have Korean translation.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT name FROM sets WHERE code IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Korean' AND NOT language LIKE '%Japanese%')
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s."name"
FROM "sets" s
INNER JOIN "set_translations" st ON s."code" = st."setcode"
WHERE st."language" = 'Korean'
AND s."code" NOT IN (
    SELECT "setcode"
    FROM "set_translations"
    WHERE "language" = 'Japanese'
)
LIMIT 500
